body:
# PASTASESSENTIALSLITE
## Overview

PastasEssentialsLite is a lightweight, highly configurable Essentials-style core plugin designed for modern Minecraft servers running Paper, Purpur, or Folia.

It provides essential survival and network commands with full customization, modern formatting support, and a clean modular system built for performance and flexibility.

This plugin is designed for SMPs, survival servers, practice servers, and lightweight networks that want a powerful essentials system without unnecessary bloat.

Prerequisites
Paper / Purpur / Folia (1.20+ recommended)
Java 17+
Table of Contents

Features
Commands
Permission Nodes
Configuration
Installation
Credits
License

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

FEATURES

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✔ Fully Configurable System
All messages, prefixes, sounds, and formats are fully editable inside config.yml.

✔ Modern Formatting Support
Supports MiniMessage, HEX colors, gradients, and legacy & color codes.

✔ Message Output Modes
Configure messages to display in:

Chat
ActionBar
Both

✔ Teleport System
Includes configurable teleport delay and cooldown system for all teleport-based commands.

✔ Join Reminder System
Optional join message system to display server branding and information.

✔ Economy Hook Support
Optional Vault-based economy integration (toggleable in config).

✔ Lightweight & Fast
Designed for performance with minimal server impact.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

COMMANDS

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

/spawn – Teleport to spawn
/setspawn – Set server spawn

/home – Teleport to your home
/sethome – Set your home

/warp <name> – Teleport to a warp

/tpa <player> – Send teleport request
/tpaccept – Accept teleport request
/tpdeny – Deny teleport request

/back – Return to last location

/msg <player> – Private message system

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

PERMISSION NODES

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

pastasessentials.admin – Full access
pastasessentials.spawn – Spawn access
pastasessentials.home – Home access
pastasessentials.warp – Warp access
pastasessentials.tpa – TPA system access
pastasessentials.msg – Messaging system access
pastasessentials.back – Back command access

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

CONFIGURATION

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Fully configurable via config.yml:

Prefix styling
Message formats (MiniMessage / HEX / legacy)
Teleport delay & cooldown
Economy integration toggle
Join reminder system
All command messages
Actionbar / chat / both display modes

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

INSTALLATION

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Download the plugin jar
Place it in your /plugins folder
Start or restart your server
Edit config.yml to customize settings
Reload or restart again
